question.text: Grignard reagent $\mathrm{RMgBr}(\mathrm{P})$ reacts with water and forms a gas (Q). One gram of Q occupies $1.4 \mathrm{dm}^{3}$ at STP. (P) on reaction with dry ice in dry ether followed by $\mathrm{H}_{3} \mathrm{O}^{+}$forms a compound (Z). 0.1 mole of (Z) will weigh $\_\_\_\_$ g. (Nearest integer)
